RESOLUTION (0.C.G.A. § 48-8-115(b)(2)(B)(i) AGREEMENT)

A RESOLUTION TO AUTHORIZE THE CITY OF CLERMONT TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH HALL COUNTY, GEORGIA, THE CITY OF GAINESVILLE, GEORGIA, THE CITY OF FLOWERY BRANCH, GEORGIA, THE CITY OF GILLSVILLE, GEORGIA, THE CITY OF LULA, GEORGIA, THE CITY OF OAKWOOD, GEORGIA, THE TOWN OF BRASELTON, GEORGIA, AND THE CITY OF BUFORD, GEORGIA, PERTAINING TO VARIOUS CAPITAL OUTLAY PROJECTS TO BE UNDERTAKEN BY HALL COUNTY, GEORGIA AND THE MUNICIPALITIES, TO CREATE, UPGRADE AND IMPROVE WATER AND SEWER SERVICE FACILITIES, PUBLIC SAFETY AND FIRE SERVICE FACILITIES, ROAD AND STREET IMPROVEMENTS, AND RECREATIONAL FACILITIES, LIBRARY FACILITIES AND OTHER AUTHORIZED CAPITAL OUTLAY PROJECTS FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE RESIDENTS OF HALL COUNTY, WHICH PROJECTS WILL BE FUNDED BY HALL COUNTY, GEORGIA, THROUGH THE IMPLEMENTATION OF A SPECIAL PURPOSE LOCAL OPTION SALES TAX AS PERMITTED BY GEORGIA LAW; AND FOR OTHER RELATED PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, the City of Clermont, Georgia (the “City” or “Clermont”), is a body politic, existing and operating under the laws and Constitution of the State of Georgia with full power to enter into contracts and agreements with other political entities; and

WHEREAS, the City is an incorporated municipality located wholly within the geographical boundaries of the County; and

WHEREAS, Hall County, Georgia (the “County”), is a body politic, existing and operating under the laws and Constitution of the State of Georgia with full power to enter into contracts and agreements with other political entities; and

WHEREAS, the City of Flowery Branch, Georgia (“Flowery Branch”), is an incorporated municipality located wholly within the geographical boundaries of the County; and

WHEREAS, the City of Gillsville, Georgia (“Gillsville”), is an incorporated municipality located partially with the geographical boundaries of the County; and

WHEREAS, the City of Gainesville, Georgia (“Gainesville”), is an incorporated municipality located wholly within the geographical boundaries of the County; and

WHEREAS, the City of Lula, Georgia (“Lula”), is an incorporated municipality located partially within the geographical boundaries of the County; and ,

WHEREAS, the City of Oakwood, Georgia (“Oakwood”) is an incorporated municipality located wholly within the geographical boundaries of the County; and

WHEREAS, the Town of Braselton, Georgia (“Braselton”) is an incorporated municipality located partially within the geographical boundaries of the County; and

WHEREAS, the City of Buford, Georgia (“Buford”) is an incorporated municipality located partially within the geographical boundaries of the County; and

WHEREAS, collectively the residents of Gillsville, Gainesville, Clermont, Lula, Oakwood, Flowery Branch, Braselton and Buford (hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Municipalities”) who live in the County constitute more than half of all of the residents of the County who live within municipalities in the County;

WHEREAS, the County desires to improve and construct roads, bridges, and related improvements located within the County; and

WHEREAS, the County desires to acquire, construct and install park and recreation facilities and equipment located within the County; and

WHEREAS, the County desires to acquire, construct and equip water and sewer facilities located within the County; and

WHEREAS, the County desires to acquire fire protection equipment and emergency medical vehicles and equipment located within the County; and

WHEREAS, the County desires to acquire, construct, remodel and equip public safety facilities, fire stations, and library facilities within the County; and

WHEREAS, the County desires to acquire, construct and equip a landfill facility located within the County; and

WHEREAS, the County desires to acquire, construct and equip certain county-wide level two projects within the County; and

WHEREAS, the Municipalities desire to improve or construct certain projects for the benefit of residents of the County and the Municipalities;

WHEREAS, the County and the Municipalities deem it appropriate to enter into an intergovernmental agreement (the “Agreement”) to undertake various capital outlay projects for the benefit of the citizens of the County and the Municipalities, which projects are to be funded with proceeds of a Special Purpose Local Option Sales Tax; and

WHEREAS, the County and the Municipalities desire to fund the capital outlay projects and the roads and streets through implementation of a Special Purpose Local Option Sales Tax as permitted by Georgia law;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, AND IT IS HEREBY RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

- 1. The execution, delivery and performance of the Agreement by the City is hereby authorized and approved. The Mayor of the City is hereby authorized to execute the Agreement in the name of and on behalf of the City with his signature attested by the Clerk of the City. The seal of the City shall be affixed to the Agreement by the Clerk of the City.

- 2. The Mayor of the City and the Clerk of the City are hereby further authorized to execute all certificates, statements, assurances, and other documents and papers required of them or either of them under the terms of the Agreement or which may otherwise reasonably be required of them to carry out the purposes and intent of the Agreement and this Resolution.

RESOLVED, ADOPTED AND APPROVED, AC day of SOWary |
